metadata.question: Between January 29 and February 5, 2019, was there at least a 22 degree Celcius difference in the highest daily air temperature at 2 meters in Boston, MA?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use ERA5-Land hourly 2m air temperature (ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY) over Boston point for 2019-01-29 to 2019-02-06 (end-exclusive). Fallback to ECMWF/ERA5/HOURLY if empty.
2. Masking strategy: No cloud masking needed (reanalysis data). Just convert Kelvin to Celsius and compute daily maxima from hourly images.
3. Validity checks: 
   - If both collections empty: C1.
   - For each daily max image, count valid pixels at the point; if any day has 0: C2.
   - If computed range is null/NaN: C3.
   - Otherwise, compare range >= 22°C to output A or B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  // Helpers
  function getInfo(obj) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      obj.getInfo((res, err) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve(res)));
    });
  }

  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const boston = ee.Geometry.Point([-71.0589, 42.3601]);
    const start = ee.Date('2019-01-29');
    const end = ee.Date('2019-02-06'); // end-exclusive to include Feb 5
    const numDays = (await getInfo(end.difference(start, 'day')))|0;

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check with fallback
    const dsIds = ['ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY', 'ECMWF/ERA5/HOURLY'];
    let usedDs = null;
    let hourly = null;

    for (let i = 0; i < dsIds.length; i++) {
      const id = dsIds[i];
      let col = ee.ImageCollection(id).filterDate(start, end).select('temperature_2m');
      const sz = await getInfo(col.size());
      if (sz > 0) {
        hourly = col;
        usedDs = id;
        break;
      }
    }

    if (!hourly) {
      console.log('Dataset: none');
      console.log('Hourly images: 0');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    const hourlyCount = await getInfo(hourly.size());
    console.log('Dataset: ' + usedDs);
    console.log('Hourly images: ' + hourlyCount);

    // 3. Build daily max images (Kelvin -> Celsius)
    const daysList = ee.List.sequence(0, numDays - 1);
    const dailyIC = ee.ImageCollection.fromImages(daysList.map(function (d) {
      d = ee.Number(d);
      const ds = start.advance(d, 'day');
      const de = ds.advance(1, 'day');
      const dayColC = hourly
        .filterDate(ds, de)
        .map(function (im) {
          return im.select('temperature_2m').subtract(273.15).rename('t2m_c')
                   .set('hourly_count', 1); // marker per image
        });
      const hasAny = dayColC.size().gt(0);
      const dayMax = ee.Image(
        ee.Algorithms.If(
          hasAny,
          dayColC.max(),
          ee.Image(0).updateMask(ee.Image(0)).rename('t2m_c')
        )
      )
        .set('date', ds.format('YYYY-MM-dd'))
        .set('system:time_start', ds.millis())
        .set('day_imgs', dayColC.size());
      return dayMax;
    }));

    // 4. Reduce per day at Boston point and collect stats
    const dailyList = dailyIC.toList(numDays);
    let recs = [];
    let anyZeroPixels = false;
    let minVal = null;
    let maxVal = null;

    for (let i = 0; i < numDays; i++) {
      const img = ee.Image(dailyList.get(i));
      const dateStr = await getInfo(img.get('date'));
      const reducer = ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true});
      const rr = img.reduceRegion({
        reducer: reducer,
        geometry: boston,
        scale: 9000,
        maxPixels: 1e9,
        bestEffort: true
      });
      const val = await getInfo(rr.get('t2m_c_mean'));
      const cnt = await getInfo(rr.get('t2m_c_count'));
      const dayImgs = await getInfo(img.get('day_imgs'));
      const pixels = cnt || 0;
      const valNum = (val === null || val === undefined) ? null : Number(val);
      recs.push({date: dateStr, tmaxC: valNum, pixels: pixels, dayImgs: dayImgs});
      console.log(dateStr + ': MaxC=' + (valNum === null ? 'null' : valNum.toFixed(1)) + ', pixels=' + pixels);

      if (pixels === 0) anyZeroPixels = true;
      if (valNum !== null && isFinite(valNum)) {
        if (minVal === null || valNum < minVal) minVal = valNum;
        if (maxVal === null || valNum > maxVal) maxVal = valNum;
      }
    }

    if (anyZeroPixels) {
      console.log('Zero valid pixels on at least one day.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    if (minVal === null || maxVal === null || !isFinite(minVal) || !isFinite(maxVal)) {
      console.log('Min/Max invalid.');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const rangeC = maxVal - minVal;
    console.log('MinC=' + minVal.toFixed(1) + ', MaxC=' + maxVal.toFixed(1) + ', RangeC=' + rangeC.toFixed(1));

    // 5. Final Answer
    const answer = (rangeC >= 22.0) ? 'A' : 'B';
    console.log(answer);
  } catch (err) {
    console.log('Error: ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : String(err)));
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
